about_the_game:
"Toto's Mini House" Official Version

Toto is not just a pet—it's a mirror of your state. When you start a focused Pomodoro timer, Toto works diligently beside you; when you decide to take a break, it relaxes and naps contentedly. This silent, synchronized companionship makes time management feel warm and motivating.

  • Creative Typing Workshop: Fingers fly across the keyboard, turning inspiration into words and coins, making dull work time lively and fun.

  • Leisurely Fishing Time: Head to a tranquil riverside to fish. Hitting hidden letters can speed up the catch.

  • Surprise Planting Paradise: Toto automatically sows seeds for you. Harvesting can unlock plants, keeping the sense of anticipation full.

  • Blind Box Collection System: Use earned coins to buy various themed blind boxes, unlocking rare seeds, ornamental flowers, and stylish furniture!

  • Home Expansion and Decoration: Freely decorate with collected furniture to create everything from a cozy mini cottage.

  • Complete Illustrated Archive: Collect all fish, plants, and furniture to light up your personal collection archive.

  • You need a Pomodoro timer but are tired of cold, impersonal tools as an efficiency seeker.

  • You love simulation management, decoration collection, and enjoy the fun of building as a player.

  • You prefer relaxed idle and clicker gameplay and are looking for a companion for your碎片时间 as a working professional or student.

  • Anyone in the digital world longing for warm, non-lonely companionship.

Relaxing Idle Gameplay | Soothing Art Style | Pomodoro Timer Companion | Deep Collection | Home Building

Welcome to the world of "Toto's Mini House." Your ideal balanced life starts here.

short_description: Do you need a caring companion in your busy daily life? Here, the super-cute little animal Toto will become your best on-screen partner, accompanying you while you work, resting with you, growing alongside you, and helping you build a unique, ideal home.
